messages.body_plain:
Applications are open for the third summer school on statistical methods
for linguistics and psychology (9-13 Sept 2019, Potsdam, Germany): Deadline
for applications: April 1, 2019. Decisions will be announced April 10,
2019. See: https://vasishth.github.io/smlp2019/  <https://t.co/ehr9mBJeZ3>

--
Shravan Vasishth
Professor for Psycholinguistics and Neurolinguistics
Department of Linguistics
University of Potsdam, Germany
http://www.ling.uni-potsdam.de/~vasishth
Academic Editor: peerj.com/ShravanVasishth

messages.subject: Questions about multinomial logistic regression
messages.body_plain:
Dear researchers,

Is there anybody know how to interpret the intercepts from a multinomial logistic regression model? And how the variables are usually coded in multinomial logistic regression? dummy coded or sum coded?

If you know the answers, please don't hesitate to contact me! Many thanks!

Best,

Yiyun Liao

PhD Candidate
Department of Psychology, Education and Child Studies
Erasmus University Rotterdam
